source.citation: Rockström J, Thilsted SH, Willett WC, Gordon LJ, Herrero M, Hicks CC, Mason-D'Croz D, Rao N, Springmann M, Wright EC, et al. The EAT-Lancet Commission on healthy, sustainable, and just food systems. Lancet. 2025;406(10510):1625-1700.

per_capita_derivation.rationale: Simple proportional cut by world population (~8 B). NOT a modelled equity allocation; the manuscript already documents (E28 Section 3, p. 1661) that the richest 30 % of the global population drives >70 % of food-system environmental pressures. The per-capita-per-day figure is an interpretive scaffold for 'is this meal a lot?', not a normative entitlement.

boundaries.label: Climate change
boundaries.current_food_system_contribution: 16-17.7 Gt CO₂e/yr (~30 % of anthropogenic emissions; E28 p. 1641)
boundaries.method_note: GWP100 (IPCC AR5) production-stage CO₂-eq aggregated from AGRIBALYSE 3.2 / Poore & Nemecek 2018.

boundaries.label: Land system change
boundaries.control_variable: Agricultural land area (current footprint, no further conversion of intact nature)
boundaries.global_boundary_unit: m² (stock, treated as m²·yr/yr proportional cut)
boundaries.global_boundary_source: E28 Table 2 row 2: <48 M km² agricultural area; treated as 48×10¹² m²·yr held per year.
boundaries.current_food_system_contribution: 48 M km² = 34 % of land surface (E28 Table 2)
boundaries.method_note: E28 land-use boundary is a STOCK (total agricultural area). ReCiPe Land use is a FLUX (m²·yr/serving). We treat the per-capita-allocated share as a comparable flux — standard LCA-vs-planetary-boundary reconciliation. The boundary asks: halt conversion of intact nature, not absolute reduction; our share is therefore an attribution proxy.

boundaries.label: Blue water consumption
boundaries.method_note: ReCiPe blue-water consumption weighted by local water-scarcity factor. The E28 boundary is an absolute global volume; we apply it as a flat per-capita allocation.

boundaries.label: Biosphere integrity (HANPP)
boundaries.control_variable: Human appropriation of net primary production
boundaries.reason_unavailable: ReCiPe Land use is a local impact metric, not a global HANPP attribution. Per-food HANPP factors require Spartina-level biodiversity modelling not available in AGRIBALYSE 3.2 or Poore & Nemecek 2018.

boundaries.label: Stratospheric ozone (N₂O)
boundaries.reason_unavailable: ReCiPe stratospheric ozone depletion is in the v1.1 method but not consumed by the platform v1 (per code_action_items.md TODO-CODE-LCA-2). AGRIBALYSE carries per-food N₂O figures — wiring this through is in scope for v2.

boundaries.label: Ocean acidification
boundaries.control_variable: CO₂ from food-chain land-use change + fossil energy
boundaries.global_boundary_source: E28 Table 2 row 5: zero CO₂ from land-use change + fossil energy in the food chain
boundaries.reason_unavailable: ReCiPe 2016 v1.1 does not include an ocean-acidification midpoint. E28 reports it as a CO₂ sub-allocation; quantifying the food-chain-attributable share requires LUC + fossil-energy disaggregation not surfaced by AGRIBALYSE.

boundaries.label: Nitrogen surplus
boundaries.reason_unavailable: Not a ReCiPe midpoint and not in AGRIBALYSE per-food columns. Closest proxy is Freshwater / Marine eutrophication, but these are local impact metrics, not nitrogen surplus.

boundaries.label: Phosphorus loss to surface water
boundaries.control_variable: P loss from agricultural land to surface water
boundaries.current_food_system_contribution: 7.2 Tg P/yr (75 % of total P loss)
boundaries.reason_unavailable: ReCiPe Freshwater eutrophication exists but is not in the v1 consumed midpoint vector (per code_action_items.md). Per-food P-loss factors are available in AGRIBALYSE and EF 3.1; wiring through is in scope for v2.

boundaries.label: Novel entities (pesticides)
boundaries.global_boundary_unit: kg PAS/yr (1 Tg high-risk avoidance; 0.2 Tg low risk)
boundaries.global_boundary_source: E28 Table 2 row 9: 1 Tg PAS/yr (high-risk avoidance); 0.2 Tg PAS/yr (low risk)
boundaries.reason_unavailable: AGRIBALYSE does not track pesticide residues / application rates. ReCiPe characterises environmental release, not ingestion. Outside the platform's v1 LCA scope by design.
